authentication.phoneConnectComputerDesc: Scan your computer's pairing QR, paste a full pairing link, or enter its 8-digit code and server address.
authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.pairingPlaceholder: Paste a full pairing link or connection share, or enter an 8-digit pairing code
authentication.manualCodeHint: Use the server address shown on your computer's pairing card. The code only verifies access; it cannot locate your computer. Do not use your phone's localhost.
authentication.addressRequired: Enter your computer's server address to use an 8-digit pairing code.
authentication.invalidAddress: Enter a full http:// or https:// server address without credentials, a query, or a fragment. Paste full pairing links in Pairing information instead.
authentication.invalidCode: The pairing code must contain 8 digits; spaces or hyphens are allowed.
authentication.connected: Paired and connected to the server
authentication.invalidLink: No valid pairing or connection share link was found.
authentication.scanPrompt: Scan the pairing QR code on your computer
authentication.scanUnavailable: This build does not support scanning. Update the mobile app or paste a pairing link.
authentication.scanPermissionDenied: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access in system settings or paste a pairing link.
authentication.scanFailed: Unable to start the camera scanner. Retry or paste a pairing link.

traffic.previewHint: May contain sensitive content. Disabling removes retained previews.
traffic.scope: This client · Application payload bytes · Excludes headers, compression differences, TLS, tunnel overhead, static assets and other clients. ? means unread or unknown body size.
traffic.previewWarning: Previews are limited and common credential fields are redacted, but may still contain conversation, file or terminal content. Disabling removes existing previews; inspect exports before sharing. Records stay in local memory and reset on reload.
traffic.search: Search URL, event, session or status code
traffic.retention: {{count}} / {{limit}} retained · {{dropped}} evicted · Cumulative totals include evicted records
traffic.noPreview: No preview retained, or the payload is not previewable JSON.

servers.connectionsDesc: Manage backend endpoints and choose which server this session uses
servers.name: Name
servers.httpsIpWarning: HTTPS direct IP connections require a certificate that includes that IP. Private or self-signed CAs may not be trusted by desktop/mobile clients.
servers.credentialsStorage: The token is stored in localStorage and sent as a Bearer token.
servers.tokenPlaceholder: Bearer token from the share link
servers.urlShareHint: You can paste an ompiui://connect share link or a full pairing link here.
servers.shareConnectLink: ompiui:// deep link (paste into another OMPiUI's add-server form)
servers.shareLanHint: This server is reachable on your LAN. Anyone with this link can connect and control it — share carefully.
servers.sharePublicHint: This server is exposed through a public entry point (reverse proxy/tunnel). Make sure the entry serves HTTPS; anyone with this link can read the workspace, open terminals, run commands and drive the agent — it is full control of this machine. Share carefully.
servers.shareLoopbackHint: This link works for clients on this machine only. To share, bind a LAN address under Service → Network listening, or configure a public base URL.
servers.shareTunnelHint: The URL is the public entry of your self-hosted relay — the phone can reach this server from any network.
servers.shareTunnelOffline: The tunnel is configured but not connected to the relay right now; this URL is temporarily unavailable and recovers automatically.
servers.deleteServerConfirm: Remove "{{name}}" from the server list? This cannot be undone.

service.title: Local OMPiUI Service
service.currentBackendDesc: Live status from the connected server, not this device's saved startup settings.
service.backendStatusUnavailable: Server status unavailable. Check the connection and server version.
service.localServiceDesc: Start and configure the service on this computer. These controls do not manage a remote server.
service.localListenDesc: Local desktop startup settings. They do not change the connected remote server.
service.localTunnelDesc: Relay settings for the service started by this desktop app. After editing, restart the local service on the Service page.
service.remoteManageHint: Change listening and relay settings on the server, then restart it. If you use OMPiUI Admin, open it separately and sign in with its own credentials.
service.remoteBackendDesc: Pair another device with the currently connected backend. Addresses and ports below come from that server.
service.remoteServerPortDesc: Reported by the current backend, not this device's local settings.
service.remotePortUnavailable: The server did not report a listening port. LAN QR pairing is unavailable. Use the known server address or update the server.
service.remoteHostUnavailable: The server did not report its listening address. LAN pairing cannot be verified; update the server.
service.remoteLanNotListening: The server listens on {{host}}, not the selected LAN adapter. Set OMPIUI_HOST to 0.0.0.0 on the server and restart it. For the local desktop service, use Service > Network listening. Check that the firewall allows access.
service.remoteRelayManageHint: No relay configured on this backend. Configure it on the server or in OMPiUI Admin, then restart the service.
service.remotePairUnavailable: Pairing needs a reachable server address and an active code.
service.terminalShellLocalDesc: Shell for new terminals. Saved on this device, separately for each server.
service.description: Manage the backend process started by the desktop app. A kept service remains identifiable after restarting OMPiUI.
service.desktopOnly: Local service management is available on desktop only.
service.webModeDesc: The local service is managed by the desktop shell. Browser mode connects to an existing OMPiUI server.
service.listenDesc: Choose the address and port the OMPiUI service binds to. Restart the service after changing them.
service.listenHostDesc: The default allows local access only. When binding to the LAN or all interfaces, check your firewall and auth token.
service.listenPortDesc: The default port is 8787. The port must be between 1 and 65535.
service.publicBaseUrlDesc: The public entry URL, e.g. https://panel.example.com. When set, share links and startup logs use it instead of the LAN address. You must run a reverse proxy or tunnel that forwards it to this server; HTTPS is strongly recommended.
service.publicBaseUrlWarning: Anyone holding a share link can read the workspace, open terminals, run commands and drive the agent — it is full control of this machine. Use a strong auth token and share only over channels you trust.
service.listenRestartHint: Binding to 0.0.0.0 or :: makes the service reachable from other devices. Do not expose it directly to the public internet.
service.tunnelDesc: Run omp-relay on a VPS; this server dials out to the relay, and the phone or external browsers open the relay's public URL — no public IP or port forwarding needed.
service.tunnelUrlDesc: Control entry of your relay, e.g. wss://relay.example.com. Printed by omp-relay init.
service.tunnelKeyDesc: The OMPIUI_TUNNEL_KEY printed by omp-relay init; must match relay.config.json on the relay.
service.tunnelIdDesc: Defaults to ompiui; must match the relay config when multiple tunnels or domain bindings exist.
service.tunnelStatusDisabled: Disabled: the service has no tunnel configured
service.tunnelRestartHint: Restart the service after changing tunnel settings. Once connected, the Share panel URL switches to the public entry automatically.
service.tunnelWarning: Anyone holding the public URL and the token can read the workspace, open terminals, run commands and drive the agent — it is full control of this machine. The relay operator and its host are treated as trusted parties.
service.remoteDesc: Watch running tasks, send instructions and get reminders on your phone. The computer is the only executor; the phone just sends requests.
service.remoteConnectionDesc: Set up the server connection first, then connect your phone below.
service.remoteServerLoginDesc: Connect the current server to your Tailnet. Sign in and complete authorization in your browser.
service.remoteConnectPhoneDesc: Scan the pairing code in OMPiUI on your phone, or paste the pairing link.
service.remotePairServerLoginRequired: Sign in to Tailscale above first. Your phone's pairing code will appear here once the server connects.
service.remotePairApprovalRequired: The server is waiting for device approval. Your phone's pairing code will appear here once approved.
service.remotePairTitle: Pair by scanning the QR code
service.remotePairDesc: The QR code is one-time only and expires in 10 minutes.
service.remoteNicDesc: Pick a LAN or Tailscale address the phone can reach. Refresh after switching networks.
service.remotePortDesc: Current server port; local listening settings are on the Service page.
service.remoteManualHint: Cannot scan? Enter the 8-digit code in your phone's Pairing information and fill in this server address.
service.remoteStep1: LAN supports a browser; for Tailscale, sign in to the same Tailnet on the phone's Authentication page
service.remoteStep2: Scan the pairing code above (or paste the full pairing info)
service.remoteStep3: Return here and confirm it shows Approved
service.remoteRelayNotConfigured: Self-hosted relay is not configured. Fill in Tunnel below, then restart the local service on the Service page.
service.remoteRelayConnected: Relay connected — the QR uses the public entry, no same network required.
service.remoteRelayOffline: Relay is offline; the QR is temporarily unavailable and recovers automatically.
service.remoteTailscaleMissing: This build does not include embedded Tailscale. Use a complete, updated OMPiUI package.
service.remoteTailscalePhoneDesc: Sign in with the same Tailscale account as your computer to connect both devices.
service.remoteTailscaleDiagnosticsCopied: Diagnostics copied. Paste them to share.
service.remoteTailscaleStartupInterrupted: The previous Tailscale startup was interrupted. Automatic recovery is paused. Copy or export login diagnostics first.
service.remoteTailscaleWaitingAuthUrl: Sign-in started, fetching the authorization link…
service.remoteTailscaleAuthReady: Authorization link ready. Open it to complete sign-in.
service.remoteTailscaleAuthorizing: Browser opened, complete authorization in the popped-up page…
service.remoteTailscaleAuthUrlTimeout: No authorization link within 30 seconds. Check the network and retry.
service.remoteTailscaleLinkFallback: Browser didn't open? Use the sign-in link
service.remoteTailscaleAuthUrlHint: If the browser did not open, tap the link or copy it to another device
service.remoteTailscaleAuthQrHint: Sign-in authorization QR — not a server pairing code
service.remotePairInvalid: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS link containing a one-time pairing code.
service.terminalTitleDesc: Choose the shell used to create PTY sessions. The list comes from the device running OMPiUI.
service.terminalShellDesc: Choose the shell used to create PTY sessions. The choice is stored per server.
service.startedByApp: Started by this OMPiUI desktop app
service.notRunning: The backend service is not running
service.autoStartDesc: Start the local OMPiUI server when the desktop app opens.
service.ompRuntimeDesc: Uses the host's official OMP CLI via omp --mode rpc; OMPiUI does not bundle an agent SDK. By default, omp is resolved from PATH. Set OMPI_OMP_BIN to an OMP executable path to override it, then restart the service.
service.backgroundLoginStartDesc: After you sign in, start the OMPiUI backend in the background without opening the desktop window. Off by default.
service.backgroundCrashRecoveryDesc: Restart with backoff only after an unexpected exit. A user stop, quitting with stop, uninstalling or updating never restarts it. OMP terminal sessions are not affected.
service.backgroundUnsupported: Background startup is available only in the Windows desktop app.
service.environmentDesc: The fixed and custom variables passed to the next server process.
service.envVarsDesc: Additional variables for the local OMPiUI server. Changes apply after starting or restarting it.

chat.pathsFormattingDesc: How file paths are displayed in messages and tools
chat.externalDropMentionModeDesc: Desktop only. When off, dropped files upload when supported and fall back to @mentions for folders or unsupported files.
chat.queueFollowupMessagesDesc: When the current session is still busy, keep new messages in a queue and send them automatically after the turn finishes
chat.conversationExperienceDesc: Message density, reasoning style, and step summary fields
chat.renderUserMarkdownDesc: Render sent user messages as Markdown when enabled; keep plain text when disabled
chat.outlineCurrentHighlightDesc: Mark the user prompt that owns the current viewport in the right-side history rail
chat.actionsOnLatestAssistantOnlyDesc: In a turn with multiple assistant messages, show fork and copy only on the last one
chat.desktopCollapsedInputDockDesc: When scrolling up through history, shrink the input into a capsule; always on for mobile, on by default on desktop
chat.descriptiveToolStepsDesc: Replace plain step counts with tool-aware summaries and show a steps line even for single tool calls
chat.processCollapseDesc: Show a live Working timer after you send, fold intermediate work into a collapsible block, and keep the final answer outside
chat.toolCardStyleDesc: Choose how tool call results are displayed
chat.immersiveModeDesc: Enable inline requests, descriptive steps and compact output together for a cleaner experience
chat.thinkingDisplayDesc: Choose capsule, low-noise italic, or markdown reasoning style
chat.showLatestOnly: Show finish info only on the latest step of a turn; hide intermediate assistants and steps
chat.completedAtFormatDesc: Choose whether to show only time or full date and time
chat.autoExpandExtensionsOnCommandDesc: Open the right extension panel after running a slash command, so the Command Feedback log is visible

agent.behaviorDesc: Permission approval and queued message behavior
agent.toolInteractionDesc: How tool requests and tool output behave inside conversations

models.visibilityDesc: Disable models you do not want to appear in the selector. Disabled models stay hidden across sessions on this server.
models.keepOneEnabled: At least one model stays enabled so the chat can still send messages.
models.empty: No models available on the current server
models.noResults: No models match the current search
models.rolesDesc: Assign models to OMP functions. Unassigned roles use automatic selection; save to apply to later sessions.
models.roleClearDesc: Remove the assignment and let OMP choose automatically.
models.roleDefaultDesc: Main model for regular chat; also the fallback when other roles are unassigned.
models.roleSmolDesc: Fast lightweight requests such as titles and summaries.
models.roleSlowDesc: Deep reasoning tasks that benefit from extended thinking.
models.roleVisionDesc: Understanding images and other visual input.
models.roleTaskDesc: Model used by subagents while executing tasks.

appearance.themePresetsDesc: Choose a base visual style for the app
appearance.customCssDesc: Override fonts, colors, and any CSS variables. Works with all themes.
appearance.customCssSpecificityHelp: Override fonts, colors, and styles. Use <1>:root:root</1> for higher specificity.
appearance.savedOverridesDesc: Name and switch between reusable CSS override snippets without changing the selected theme
appearance.wideModeDesc: Expand chat area for long outputs
appearance.glassEffectDesc: Apply backdrop blur to floating panels like input box, menus, and dialogs
appearance.diffStyleDesc: How changes are indicated in the diff gutter
appearance.uiFontScaleDesc: Adjust the font size for menus, labels, and other UI elements
appearance.codeFontScaleDesc: Adjust the font size for code blocks, diffs, and terminal
appearance.codeBlockThemesDesc: Pick the syntax highlighting theme for code blocks. Light and dark can be set separately and switch with your color mode.
appearance.codeBlockThemeLightDesc: Syntax theme used when the color mode resolves to light
appearance.codeBlockThemeDarkDesc: Syntax theme used when the color mode resolves to dark
appearance.codeWordWrapDesc: Wrap code blocks and diffs to the available width to reduce horizontal scrolling
appearance.wakeLockDesc: Prevent the screen from dimming or locking while the app is in the foreground
appearance.languageDesc: Choose the display language for the interface
appearance.folderStyleRecentsDesc: Group recent chats by project folder while keeping the default list available
appearance.showChildSessionsDesc: Always list child sessions under their parent. When off, only active or selected children are shown.

workspace.layoutDesc: Workspace layout, reading comfort, and code viewing preferences
workspace.manualTerminalTitlesDesc: When enabled, terminal tabs stop following shell title changes and can be renamed manually. When disabled, terminal tabs continue to follow shell or process titles automatically.
workspace.terminalDesc: Terminal copy, paste, and mouse behavior. Basic paste and Ctrl/Cmd+C copy with a selection are always available.
workspace.terminalCopyOnSelectDesc: Automatically copy the terminal selection when the mouse is released. When off, selections are copied only with Ctrl/Cmd+C.
workspace.terminalRightClickPasteDesc: Right click copies the terminal selection when one exists, otherwise it reads clipboard text and pastes it. When enabled, this replaces the browser context menu.
workspace.sidebarDesc: Sidebar layout and recent chat organization

notifications.notifyWhenComplete: Notify when AI completes a response
notifications.notAvailable: System notifications are not available in this environment
notifications.notificationTypesDesc: Choose which notification types are enabled
notifications.inAppAlertsDesc: Toast notifications for background session events
notifications.soundEnabledDesc: Play notification sounds for session events
notifications.currentSessionSoundDesc: Also play sounds for events in the active session
notifications.eventSoundsDesc: Configure notification sounds for each event type
notifications.eventPermissionDesc: When a session needs your approval
notifications.eventQuestionDesc: When AI is waiting for your input
notifications.eventErrorDesc: When a session encounters an error
notifications.eventWarningDesc: When a session reports a warning notice
notifications.eventInfoDesc: When a session reports an informational notice
notifications.supportedFormats: MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, AAC, WebM
notifications.soundNotSupported: Sound playback is not supported in this environment

about.versionCardDesc: Check whether a newer OMPiUI release is available and jump to the download page.
about.backupCardDesc: Export your local settings to a JSON backup, or restore them later on another device.
about.backupWarning: Backups include local server credentials, service environment variables, and other sensitive settings stored in this browser/app profile. Keep the file private.
about.statusIdle: Check for updates to see whether a newer version is available.
about.statusUpToDate: You are already on the latest version.
about.statusNoRelease: No OMPiUI release has been published yet.
about.backupImportConfirm: Importing a backup will replace the current local settings and reload the app. Continue?
about.backupImportConfirmWithDate: Import the backup created at {{date}}? This will replace the current local settings and reload the app.
about.toastBody: Click to open About and view the release page.

keybindings.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
keybindings.clickToRebind: Click a shortcut to rebind. Enter confirm, Esc cancel.

pi.title: Runtime
pi.openWorkspace: Open a workspace to configure its runtime.
pi.runtimeDescription: Edit global config.yml overrides. Project settings and effective values are shown under Advanced options.
pi.patchLabel: Global patch: official nested/dotted keys; null resets an override
pi.patchInvalidJson: Settings patch must be a JSON object
pi.description: Manage official OMP configuration and project resources.
pi.modelDefaultsDescription: The default selector is stored in modelRoles.default; other roles are preserved. Clear a field to remove its global override.
pi.thinkingDescription: Stores defaultThinkingLevel using the installed OMP registry's supported levels, including automatic model-based selection.
pi.compactionDescription: Summarize older messages as the context approaches its limit.
pi.retryDescription: Try again automatically after retryable request errors.
pi.skillCommandsDescription: Allow skills to be invoked with slash commands.
pi.blockImagesDescription: Prevent images from being sent to the model (images.blockImages), not image display in this interface.
pi.advancedDescription: Changes persist to the official global configuration. JSON patches accept registered settings only, merge record entries, and use null to remove overrides.
pi.steeringDescription: How to deliver messages added while the Agent is working.
pi.followUpDescription: How to process queued messages after the Agent finishes.
pi.runtimeThemeDescription: Only affects the OMP terminal, not this interface.
pi.saveHint: Save writes changed global keys only; project overrides may still take precedence. Existing sessions follow native reload behavior.
pi.resourceToolsDescription: The session's tools and their enabled status.
pi.resourceExtensionsDescription: Add tools, commands, or event responses to the session.
pi.resourceCommandsDescription: Slash commands you can run from the chat input.
pi.resourceSkillsDescription: Task guides and instructions that can be loaded when needed.
pi.resourceContextDescription: Project instructions and background from AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and other context files.
pi.resourcesHandlerUnknown: Handler registration is unknown: this runtime's handler list is unavailable.
pi.resourcesPromptPathUnavailable: Source file path unavailable in this OMP version
pi.resourcesAdvancedDescription: Inspect event handlers and raw data when troubleshooting an extension. These checks do not change the session.
pi.resourceHandlersDescription: Session events that extensions listen to. Enter a name to check whether a handler is registered.
pi.resourcesNoExtensionUi: No extension UI state is available for this session.
pi.sessionControlsDescription: Model shortlist, waiting for work to finish, and changing sessions.
pi.scopedModelsDescription: Choose models for “Next model” to cycle through. One model ID or pattern per line; runtime support is required.
pi.waitForIdleDescription: Wait for current work to finish without stopping the model or cancelling its work.
pi.sessionChangeDescription: Open a saved session from this workspace. You will leave the current conversation.
pi.noOtherSessions: There are no other saved sessions in this workspace.
pi.newNativeSessionDescription: This replaces the currently running session with a blank one and switches to it.
pi.sessionMessagesDescription: Send a user message or submit a prompt directly to the model.
pi.sessionDeliveryDescription: Default sends immediately when idle and queues a follow-up while busy. Steer adds guidance to current work; Follow-up waits until the turn finishes.
pi.sessionPromptDescription: Send a prompt directly to the model. The delivery choice above does not apply.
pi.sessionBashDescription: Run a one-off Bash command in this session. Commands run for real and may change files.
pi.sessionExportDescription: Save to a path on the OMP host. HTML is for reading; JSONL preserves the raw session data.
pi.extensionHostCommandsDescription: For extension development or debugging; runtime support is required. Not needed for ordinary chats.
pi.sendCustomMessageDescription: Convert the data to text and send it as a visible extension message.
pi.appendCustomEntryDescription: Append the JSON data to the session record as a custom entry.
pi.packagesDescription: Manage official OMP plugins. Resolve is a read-only inspection of installed files or explicit local directories: it never installs missing packages, runs extensions, or starts MCP servers. These results are not the resources already loaded in an open session.
pi.sourcePlaceholder: npm package, Git URL, name@marketplace, or local directory
pi.nativePluginScopeDescription: Project scope is supported for marketplace plugins only. npm, Git, and local links use user scope. Enable state is the scoped install preference; project overrides may still disable resources. Reload an open session after changing plugins.
pi.marketplaceSourcesDescription: Sources are shared within the current OMP profile. Installing a remote marketplace catalog explicitly fetches it.
pi.marketplaceSourcePlaceholder: owner/repo, Git URL, catalog URL, or local marketplace directory
pi.projectNpmReadOnly: Discovered project npm/link plugin; official lifecycle management is user-only.
pi.nativePluginUpdatesDescription: Check updates explicitly refreshes all marketplace catalogs only. Update refreshes the relevant catalogs and force-reinstalls npm/Git plugins, upgrades marketplace plugins, or refreshes local links in the selected scope while preserving enable state and feature selection. Bulk project update skips read-only npm/Git/link entries.
pi.packageOperationPending: Processing plugin operation… Changes appear after the official manager completes.
pi.resourcesOpenSession: Open a session to see its loaded tools, extensions, and context.
pi.resourcesDescription: See the current session's loaded resources. Refreshing this view is read-only. Native reload re-reads the session and refreshes skills/file commands; this OMP version does not hot-reload extension factories or prompt templates.
pi.sessionOpenSession: Open a session to view its status and use session commands.
pi.sessionDescription: Inspect the current session, change models, or expand a task below. Commands apply to this session.
pi.userMessagePlaceholder: Write a message for this session
pi.promptPlaceholder: Write a prompt to send directly
pi.excludeBash: Keep command output out of the model context
pi.outputPath: Output file path on the host
pi.invalidJson: Custom payload must be valid JSON

providers.title: Model providers
providers.description: Manage OMP custom model providers (~/.omp/agent/models.yml). Each provider can fetch, edit and verify its own models.
providers.emptyHint: Add a provider to fetch models from its upstream, or add a model ID manually.
providers.unsupported: This runtime has no models.yml, so provider settings are unavailable.
providers.emptyModelsHint: Fetch models from this provider, or add a model ID manually.
providers.addHint: Enter the compatible endpoint details; models can be fetched after saving.
providers.name: Name
providers.apiKeyHint: The API key is only written to ~/.omp/agent/models.yml on this machine.
providers.deleteProviderMessage: This removes "{{name}}" and all of its local model configuration. It cannot be undone.
providers.clearModelsMessage: This removes all {{count}} local model entries under "{{name}}". Upstream models are untouched.
providers.deleteModelMessage: This removes {{modelId}} from "{{name}}". The upstream API is untouched.
providers.pickerNoBaseUrl: Fill in the Base URL and API key first
providers.smartConfigHint: Fill model capabilities from models.dev, with a local fallback
providers.smartApplied: Recommended values applied from the model ID
providers.inputTypesHint: Which attachments the chat UI may send to this model
providers.reasoningHint: Enables reasoning levels in the chat model picker
providers.reasoningLevelsHint: Low to high; click to toggle
providers.reasoningParamsHint: Map UI reasoning levels to provider request parameters as a JSON object
providers.modelIdDuplicate: A model with this ID already exists for the provider
providers.invalidNumbers: Context window and max output must be positive integers
providers.invalidJson: Reasoning parameter map must be a valid JSON object
providers.noReasoningLevels: The model supports reasoning but lists no configurable levels.
